description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average hidden state mean across different layers of a model, with three distinct lines representing different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and is also a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 1, ranging from 0 to 4. The first line, represented by a blue dashed line, indicates the hidden state mean before a gate, with an average value of 0.71. This line remains relatively flat across the layers, with a slight increase towards the end. The second line, shown as a red dotted line, represents the hidden state mean after a gate, with an average value of 0.05. This line is also relatively flat and close to the x-axis, indicating a low mean value. The third line, depicted as a green solid line, corresponds to the hidden state mean of the baseline, with an average value of 0.04. This line is the lowest among the three, remaining close to the x-axis throughout the layers. The plot does not include any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the initial data points provided.
